notes.title: We are on the air!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

Glad to deliver the news to you that the game has been released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058658/d1f6e968c1fe8c8e236daf328aad26774e9d1fcb.png[/img]

So, let me briefly remind you why you should buy the game:

- Lots of strawberry content, which is played by the game itself. It's not pre-made renders or anything like that. 
- Fun combat system.
- Ability to customise your robot
- Customisation of the main character. From his penis to the ears on his head.
- Hot voiceover of strawberry scenes.
- Great soundtracks.
- Destructible enemies.
- You will be able to eat ramen or sushi in the game.

And let's not forget that this is definitely not the latest build of the game. I plan to improve the combat system to make it as enjoyable and fun as possible for you to play for an unlimited amount of time.

Don't swear too much if something goes wrong in the game. Write me a message about bugs or problems in the game in the comments on the page. I will try to fix it as quickly as possible.

Enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975250/Sexy_Futa_Mecha_Battles_of_Islands/

notes.title: #Devlog 0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058658/c589139a7d267235a99d23caccc49692e368fa01.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058658/85334fde06be365206a25e4992f2277b5e9a0ddb.png[/img]

In the next few posts, I'll talk more about the combat system and reveal some strawberry content.

See you very soon at the release, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist
